Definition: wheat, whether the grain or the plant
BiblicalUsage: Chittah is wheat, the grain of the harvest, and it appears at the turning points of three stories. Ruth gleans through the wheat harvest, the men of Beth-shemesh are reaping their wheat harvest when the ark returns, and Solomon gives Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for his household.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wheat in the Bible is always provision on the way to something more, because Ruth's harvest leads to a home and the ark's return leads to worship. I hold that God feeds His people in the middle of their story, not only at the end of it.
